known_gaps: Per-entity `stated_in` provenance for the full entity set (milestones, tasks, risks, synergies, decisions, actions, dependencies, assumptions, issues) is not yet exported here — only the 6 planted conflicts and 10 injected errors are. Full entity-level export would require tracing every field through the g2_*.py generators the way this script's conflict mapping was traced, and is needed before metric S1 (extraction recall) can be scored per-entity. The gate metrics (P1-P5) and detection metrics (S2, S3) do not need it.
